g.text: After — the campaign is an object the till holds
Two methods, both about the algorithm.
No appliesTo, no priority, no isBetterThan —
the moment a rule ranks itself against the
others, every rule knows every other rule.
Not a percentage at all. Had the interface
not the strategies, not the context. A small
object whose only job is choosing.
basket five ways, and names no campaign class
